title.zh: 跨步的同一：标签不承载任何东西，每一步与每个条件只由关系确定，追随形成的读法依赖谁延续谁；单向的连续留下接续，双向的连续仍留下跨过休眠的接续；更多在每种没有分裂的延续下迫使生起
title.en: Identity across steps: labels carry nothing, each step and each condition are fixed by relations, and readings that follow a formation depend on who continues whom; continuity read one way leaves succession, and read both ways still leaves succession across dormancy; more forces arising under every continuation without splits

claim.zh: 依存网用固定的索引类型给形成命名，一步的哪个形成与下一步的哪个形成相同由名字规定。改认在每一步把两种命名一一对应，保持每一步的水平、活动、依存与汲取；每一步都相同的改认是改名。改名保持由关系定义、追随形成的读法（检查了五种）：形成在整段上更新或消耗、依存的任期、侵蚀、依存的形成与消解、生起与不息；标签不承载任何东西，名字跨步的模式承载同一。任何改认保持每一步的支持、保持与断裂，每个条件被更新、被消耗或失去，活动是否只在有支持处，每个事件是否在更新之内与是否断裂；改认一个流，保持每步的取用与给予、消耗与补充的平衡、取用者与补充者的数目，因而保持不止地更多；活跃形成的普查与“只有活跃的形成取用”也保持，所以在它们之下，不止地更多在每个改认下蕴含不息，花园满足全部这些前提。只改动谁延续谁（每一奇数步交换名字），一个更新、一个消耗的形成变成两个消耗、没有更新；第一步之后汲取者每步侵蚀，变成没有任何事件侵蚀；没有依存形成也没有生起，变成一个形成转化依存、形成在每一奇数步生起，生成不息。单由命名造成的生起可以满足 Unceasing.regeneration_recurs 的全部前提：Depletes 不系于生起的形成，不筛掉命名的产物。保持跨步持续活动的形成的名字，改认不制造生起，因而不制造不息；保持跨步持续依存的形成的名字，改认使形成在一段任期上只有一个名字，保持在任期中满足过的依存，不去掉侵蚀。这两个条件以旧命名为参照：新命名可以把旧命名分开的形成接起来，制造连续，不能去掉连续。把终结的形成与在该步或其后开始的形成接起来是接续：谱系的两个成员交替活跃，分开命名时不息地生起，合为一个命名时始终活跃、没有生起；继承者在第二步活跃并被满足、自第三步起需要多于池中所有，分开命名时长者失去之后的汲取不侵蚀，继承者接续长者时自第三步起每一步都侵蚀；两个见证中，合并的命名保持分开命名的连续，分开命名不保持合并命名的连续。新命名的连续也由旧命名保持时（双向），生起、不息与侵蚀恰被保持，同一步的接续被排除；跨过形成都不活跃、不依存的休眠之步接起来，双向保持连续，仍改变哪个形成更新、哪个消耗。延续关系读出分裂与合并：在每种没有形成延续为两个的延续关系下（允许合并；每个改认都是这样的延续），普查之下不止地更多使形成在任意晚的步生起；把新形成读作从既有形成萌出时，同样的增长在第一步之后不迫使任何生起。把谱系本身与成员并列命名，谱系每步活跃，成员不息地生起；依存网没有部分与整体的关系。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: A web names its formations by a fixed index type, so which formation at one step is the same as which at the next is stipulated by the names. A re-identification relates two namings one to one at each step and keeps every step's levels, activity, dependences and drawing; a renaming is a re-identification that is the same at every step. A renaming preserves the readings, defined from the relations, that follow a formation (checked for five): renewing or consuming in the run, the tenure of a dependence, undermining, forming and dissolving of dependences, arising and unceasing generation; labels carry nothing, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. Every re-identification preserves each step's support, keeping and breaking, whether each condition is renewed, consumed or lost, whether activity occurs only where supported, and whether each event is within renewal and whether it breaks; re-identifying a flow preserves what is taken and given at each step, the balance of depletion and replenishment, and the numbers of takers and renewers, so more without end; a census of the active formations and that only active formations take carry over too, so under them more without end makes generation unceasing under every re-identification, and the garden meets all these premises. Changing only who continues whom (exchanging names at every odd step), a renewing and a consuming formation become two consuming and none renewing; a drawer undermining at every step after the first becomes a web in which no event then undermines; a web in which no dependence forms and nothing arises becomes one in which a formation transforms its dependence and formations arise at every odd step, so that generation is unceasing. Arisings made by naming alone can meet every premise of Unceasing.regeneration_recurs: Depletes is not tied to the arising formation and does not screen out what naming makes. Keeping the names of formations active across a step, a re-identification makes no arising, hence no unceasing generation; keeping the names of formations whose dependence continues across a step, it gives a formation one name over a tenure, keeps every dependence met while it held, and removes no undermining. Both conditions are read against the old naming: the new naming may join formations the old keeps apart, making a continuity, and never removes one. Joining a formation that ends with one that begins at that step or later is succession: two members of a lineage active at alternate steps arise without end when named apart and are always active with nothing arising when named as one; an heir active and supported at the second step that needs more of the pool than it holds from the third makes drawing after an elder's loss undermine nothing when named apart, and undermine at every step from the third when it succeeds the elder; in both witnesses the joined naming keeps the apart naming's continuity and the apart naming does not keep the joined naming's. When the old naming also keeps the new naming's continuity (both ways), arising, unceasing generation and undermining are preserved exactly and succession at a single step is excluded; joining across a dormant step, at which neither formation is active or depends on anything, keeps continuity both ways and still changes which formation renews and which consumes. Continuation relations read splits and merges: under every continuation in which no formation continues as two (merges allowed; every re-identification is such a continuation), more without end under a census makes formations arise at arbitrarily late steps; reading new formations as budding from one already there, the same growth forces no arising after the first step. Naming the lineage itself beside its members, the lineage is active at every step while its members arise without end; a web has no part–whole relation. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 改认在每一步是一一对应。分裂与合并（一个形成延续为几个，或几个延续为一个）不是改认：它们改变延续关系，不改变任何一步形成的数目；它们由延续关系（Continues）表示。
hypotheses.en: A re-identification is one to one at each step. Splits and merges, in which one formation continues as several or several as one, are not re-identifications: they change the continuation relation, not the number of formations at any step; continuation relations (Continues) represent them.

hypotheses.zh: 连续读作：跨一步持续活动的形成保持名字（KeepsActive），跨一步持续依存于某条件的形成保持名字（KeepsTenure）。以旧命名为参照是单向的读法；另以新命名为参照（Reidentify.back）是双向的读法。两者都是作者的读法，不是同一的定义。
hypotheses.en: Continuity is read as: formations active across a step keep their names (KeepsActive), and formations whose dependence on a condition continues across a step keep their names (KeepsTenure). Read against the old naming, it is one-way; read also against the new naming (Reidentify.back), it is two-way. Both are the author's readings, not a definition of identity.

hypotheses.zh: 流的改认按每步一一对应改写 present；present 每步只列每个参与的形成一次仍是对应前提。
hypotheses.en: Re-identifying a flow rewrites present one to one at each step; that present lists each formation taking part once per step remains a correspondence premise.

hypotheses.zh: More.unceasing_reidentified 用 more-needs-renewers 的普查、present 不重复与 Taking，以及活跃的可判定性（定理的假设，不是公理）。
hypotheses.en: More.unceasing_reidentified uses the census, present without repetition and Taking of more-needs-renewers, and decidable activity (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).

hypotheses.zh: Flow.More.unceasingFrom 另用：延续关系中没有形成延续为两个（NoSplit），以及“是否延续某个活跃形成”可判定（定理的假设，不是公理）。
hypotheses.en: Flow.More.unceasingFrom also uses that no formation continues as two under the continuation (NoSplit), and that whether a formation continues an active one is decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom).

correspondence.zh: 开放纲领与 becoming-dependence-dynamics 的下一步把形成的个体化列为待做：终止与转化之分依赖外给的同一。本结果陈述这一外给的同一在哪些读法中起作用：每一步与每个条件的读法不依赖它，追随形成的读法依赖它；单向的连续排除制造生起与去掉侵蚀，接续仍由读法决定；双向的连续恰保持生起与侵蚀，却仍不约束形成在整段上的类。名字跨步的模式承载同一：这是表示给出的对应前提，Turnover 表明它是实质的；方法要求“不能以分别命名偷渡独立本体”在这里的检查是这一披露，不是改名不变，因为改名按构造保持这一模式。谱系与成员是同一展开的两个层次：作为整体的谱系持续，正由成员不息地生起而成（Layered）；单一命名层次只能表示其一，部分与整体的关系是这一表示所省略的关系。把“生生不息”读到谱系、成员或两者的层次，属于 Ren；只读作谱系的持续，与 Ren 原话中的“不断创造”有张力（作者的说明）。继承者是否继承长者的损失，决定此后的汲取在工作读法下是否侵蚀，也属于 Ren 的读法选择。
correspondence.en: The open programme and the next step of becoming-dependence-dynamics list the individuation of formations: the distinction between ending and transformation depends on a supplied identity. This result states in which readings that supplied identity matters: readings of each step and each condition do not depend on it, readings that follow a formation do; continuity read one way rules out making arising and removing undermining, and succession remains a reading; read both ways it preserves arising and undermining exactly, and still does not constrain a formation's class over the run. The pattern of names across steps carries identity: this is a correspondence premise the representation supplies, and Turnover shows it is substantive; the check of the method requirement that separate naming must not smuggle in independent entities is this disclosure, not invariance under renaming, since a renaming keeps the pattern by construction. A lineage and its members are two levels of one unfolding: the lineage as a whole continues precisely as its members arise without end (Layered); a single level of naming represents only one of them, and the part–whole relation is what this representation omits. Whether 生生不息 is read at the level of the lineage, of its members or both is Ren's to choose; reading it only as the lineage's continuation is in tension with the “不断创造” of Ren's words (the author's note). Whether an heir inherits an elder's loss, deciding whether later drawing undermines on the working reading, is also Ren's reading choice.

detail.zh: 复用依存网、支持、保持、断裂、任期、侵蚀、形成与消解，以及该记录下一步中的个体化问题。
detail.en: Reuses webs, support, keeping, breaking, tenure, undermining, forming and dissolving, and the individuation question in that record's next step.

input.zh: 改认、不变性与依赖同一的读法。

detail.zh: 复用 Arises、Unceasing、Depletes、Rises、Falls 与 Unceasing.regeneration_recurs；说明不息依赖同一。在 Turnover 中单由改认制造的生起不降低任何条件，Depletes 不成立；在 TideFlip 中单由命名造成的生起满足 Depletes 与全部前提，所以 Depletes 不筛掉命名的产物。
detail.en: Reuses Arises, Unceasing, Depletes, Rises, Falls and Unceasing.regeneration_recurs; shows that unceasing generation depends on identity. In Turnover the arisings made by re-identification alone lower no condition and Depletes fails; in TideFlip the arisings made by naming alone meet Depletes and every premise, so Depletes does not screen out what naming makes.

input.zh: 生起在改认与连续下的行为。
input.en: How arising behaves under re-identification and continuity.

detail.zh: 复用流、取用者、补充者、More、普查、Taking、More.grows 与 More.unceasing；说明它们不依赖同一，并把“更多蕴含不息”推广到每个改认，以及每种没有分裂的延续。
detail.en: Reuses flows, takers, renewers, More, censuses, Taking, More.grows and More.unceasing; shows that they do not depend on identity, and extends “more implies unceasing” to every re-identification and to every continuation without splits.

output.zh: 流、消耗与补充的平衡、计数、普查与更多蕴含不息。
output.en: Flows, the balance of depletion and replenishment, counts, censuses, and more implying unceasing generation.

conditions.zh: 普查、present 不重复与 Taking（只用于 More.unceasing_reidentified 与 More.unceasingFrom；后者另需 NoSplit）。
conditions.en: A census, present without repetition and Taking (only for More.unceasing_reidentified and More.unceasingFrom; the latter also needs NoSplit).

detail.zh: 工作读法“活跃且不侵蚀”经由任期依赖跨步的同一；接续是否延续任期是该读法的一个选择。
detail.en: The working reading “active and not undermining” depends on identity across steps through tenure; whether succession continues a tenure is a choice within that reading.

detail.zh: 关系整体与分化：每一步与每个条件的规定只由关系确定；跨步的同一是表示提供的，单向的连续把它约束到接续为止，双向的连续把它约束到跨过休眠的接续为止；部分与整体的关系没有表示。整体的演绎仍开放。
detail.en: Relational unity and differentiation: determinations of each step and each condition are fixed by relations; identity across steps is supplied by the representation, continuity read one way constrains it up to succession, and read both ways up to succession across dormancy; the part–whole relation is not represented. The whole deduction remains open.

detail.zh: Turnover：只改动谁延续谁，形成的类、侵蚀、转化与生起都改变，不息由改认单独制造；在 Turnover 中这些生起不降低任何条件，Depletes 不成立。
detail.en: Turnover: changing only who continues whom changes formation classes, undermining, transformation and arising, and unceasing generation is made by re-identification alone; in Turnover those arisings lower no condition and Depletes fails.

detail.zh: TideFlip：没有生起的潮水与月亮，每个奇数步交换名字，单由命名造成的生起满足 Unceasing.regeneration_recurs 的全部前提；Depletes 不筛掉命名的产物（第五次独立审查 I8）。
detail.en: TideFlip: the tide and the moon with nothing arising, their names exchanged at every odd step; arisings made by naming alone meet every premise of Unceasing.regeneration_recurs, so Depletes does not screen out what naming makes (fifth independent review I8).

detail.zh: Lineage 与 Succession：保持单向连续的改认仍可隐藏生起、增加侵蚀，继承者活跃并在其第一个活跃步被满足；两者都是接续，合并的命名只单向保持连续（Lineage.one_way、Succession.one_way，第五次独立审查 I5、I11）。
detail.en: Lineage and Succession: re-identifications keeping one-way continuity can still hide arising and add undermining, with an heir active and supported at its first active step; both are succession, and the joined naming keeps continuity only one way (Lineage.one_way, Succession.one_way, fifth independent review I5, I11).

detail.zh: Dormancy：跨过休眠之步接起来，双向保持连续，仍改变形成的类：分开命名时早的形成更新、晚的形成消耗，接起来后名为“早”的形成消耗而不更新（第五次独立审查 I6）。
detail.en: Dormancy: joining across a dormant step keeps continuity both ways and still changes a formation's class: named apart, the early formation renews and the late one consumes; joined, the formation named early consumes and does not renew (fifth independent review I6).

detail.zh: Budding：在循环中普查、present 不重复、Taking 与不止地更多都成立；把新形成读作从形成 0 萌出（一个形成延续为多个），第一步之后没有任何生起：分裂恰是使“更多迫使生起”失效的东西（第五次独立审查 I9）。
detail.en: Budding: in the cycle the census, present without repetition, Taking and more without end all hold; reading new formations as budding from formation 0 (one formation continuing as many), nothing arises after the first step: splits are exactly what defeats “more forces arising” (fifth independent review I9).

detail.zh: Layered：把谱系本身与成员并列命名，谱系每步活跃，成员不息地生起；谱系与成员之间部分与整体的关系不在依存网中（第五次独立审查 I10）。
detail.en: Layered: naming the lineage itself beside its members, the lineage is active at every step while its members arise without end; the part–whole relation between them is not in the web (fifth independent review I10).

detail.zh: 第五次独立审查：P12 的全部声明接受，公理报告为空；连续只单向、休眠中的接续、“名字不承载任何东西”、命名造成的生起满足 P10 的前提、“每种同一的读法”与对分裂的描述、谱系的二选一、继承者从不活跃，以及依赖同一的读法未在其记录中注明（已更正，整合文档 §19）。
detail.en: Fifth independent review: every P12 declaration is accepted with empty axiom reports; one-way continuity, succession across dormancy, “names carry nothing”, naming-made arisings meeting the P10 premises, “every reading of identity” and the description of splits, the lineage either/or, the heir that never lives, and identity-dependent readings unmarked in their records (corrected, integration note §19).

limitations.zh: 不含伦理谓词；改认只处理每步形成一一对应的情形；分裂与合并由延续关系表示，其下只陈述了更多迫使的生起，形成的类、任期与侵蚀没有陈述；连续是一种同一的读法，不是同一的定义，单向与双向是两种读法，双向的连续也不约束跨过休眠的接续；More.unceasing_reidentified 与 More.unceasingFrom 只在普查、present 不重复与 Taking 之下成立，不说哪个形成生起，在萌出的读法下迫使的只是活跃形成的数目没有界；接续怎样读、工作读法是否让任期经由接续延续、“生生不息”读到哪个层次，属于 Ren 的读法选择；依存网没有部分与整体的关系；从关系推出同一的完整说明（物质、信息或组织的连续）没有给出；见证都是最小见证。
limitations.en: Contains no ethical predicate; re-identification covers only one-to-one correspondence of formations at each step; splits and merges are represented by continuation relations, under which only the arising forced by more is stated, not formation classes, tenure or undermining; continuity is one reading of identity, not its definition, one-way and two-way continuity are two readings, and even two-way continuity does not constrain succession across dormancy; More.unceasing_reidentified and More.unceasingFrom hold only under a census, present without repetition and Taking, do not say which formation arises, and under budding what is forced is only that the active formations have no bound; how to read succession, whether the working reading lets a tenure continue through succession, and at which level 生生不息 is read are Ren's reading choices; a web has no part–whole relation; a full account deriving identity from relations (continuity of material, information or organization) is not given; the witnesses are minimal.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261009T060305.410034Z）：Becoming.Identity 77 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 19 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 559 项定理／948 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。作者反审见整合文档 §16；另一 agent（Claude Opus 5.5，未参与撰写）作了独立审查（BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md），其更正在整合文档 §19 处理，更正尚未再经独立审查。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 21 个模块，其中每条声明的公理报告为空，并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261009T060305.410034Z): all 77 theorems of Becoming.Identity have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 19 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 559 theorems/948 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The author's counterreview is in §16 of the integration note; a separate agent (Claude Opus 5.5, not an author) reviewed it independently (BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md), and its corrections, handled in §19, have not been independently reviewed again. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 21 modules, every declaration in it has an empty axiom report, and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 接续的读法（谱系、成员或两者的层次；继承者是否继承损失），由 Ren 选择；跨过休眠也成立的连续读法（例如不活跃时持续的依存）；形成之间部分与整体关系的表示；延续关系下形成的类、任期与侵蚀；从物质、信息或组织的连续推出同一。
next_delta.en: The reading of succession (the level of the lineage, its members or both; whether an heir inherits a loss), for Ren to choose; a continuity reading that reaches across dormancy (for example a dependence that persists while inactive); a representation of part–whole relations among formations; formation classes, tenure and undermining under continuation relations; deriving identity from continuity of material, information or organization.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：P12b 按第五次独立审查（BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md）更正：“名字不承载任何东西”改为标签不承载任何东西，名字跨步的模式承载同一；连续分为单向与双向两种读法，新增双向定理、Lineage.one_way、Succession.one_way、Dormancy、TideFlip、Garden.unceasing_reidentified 与 Layered；Succession 的继承者改为活跃并被满足；分裂与合并改述为延续关系的改变，新增延续关系、NoSplit、More.unceasingFrom、continuation_reidentify 与 Budding；谱系的 AI 论证改为两个层次与省略的部分整体关系。交换名字的见证共用 Reidentify.exchanging。合并检查器重跑（20261009T060305.410034Z）。标题、主张、假设、对应、反例、界限与下一步随之改写。
history.en: 2026-10-09: P12b corrected this record following the fifth independent review (BECOMING-P11B-P12-REVIEW.md): “names carry nothing” became “labels carry nothing”, with the pattern of names across steps carrying identity; continuity was split into one-way and two-way readings, with the two-way theorems, Lineage.one_way, Succession.one_way, Dormancy, TideFlip, Garden.unceasing_reidentified and Layered added; Succession's heir now lives and is supported; splits and merges are described as changes of the continuation relation, with continuation relations, NoSplit, More.unceasingFrom, continuation_reidentify and Budding added; the lineage AI argument became two levels with the part–whole relation omitted. The name-exchanging witnesses share Reidentify.exchanging. The consolidated checker was rerun (20261009T060305.410034Z). Title, claim, hypotheses, correspondence, counterexamples, limitations and next step were rewritten accordingly.
